entities.name: Mkrtichʻ Peshiktʻashlyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mkrtich Beshiktashlian was an Ottoman Armenian poet, playwright and educator from Constantinople. Considered one of the main representatives of the Romanticist movement in Armenian literature, his work was highly influential on later Armenian authors.
